Use aurelia-agent-core, evidence-reconciliation, security-review and risk-and-capital-controls.
The existing AURELIA capital plane is the only component permitted to request execution. Risk Warden, Execution Firewall, Balance Truth, Account Isolation, reconciliation, LIVE_LOCK and FINAL_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION are authoritative and fail closed.
